root.text: TRN-02 · Create an industrial property tax bill for this year

children.text:
Story: As a treasury clerk, I want to create a real property tax bill for an industrial property this year so that the city can collect its Basic and SEF (Special Education Fund) tax.
Acceptance criteria:
- Basic = 2% of the assessed value
- SEF = 1% of the assessed value
- Both lines start OPEN
- Wrong values and a wrong PIN are refused with a clear message; one PIN per city
- The bill shows in My data › My bills, and only to me

Setup (API)
Headers on every call: X-Tenant-ID: TAGAYTAY, X-User-ID: <your name-tag>, Content-Type: application/json
POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers {"full_name":"Ana Dela Cruz","mobile":"<new mobile>"} → 201, save taxpayer_id
Every bill POST sends {"taxpayer_id":"<taxpayer_id>","pin":…,"property_class":"INDUSTRIAL","assessed_value":…,"tax_year":2026}
Training setup › section 2: create the bill
Upon page load: is the form clear for a clerk?

T10 · Numbers + · The largest value allowed
POST /api/v1/training/rpt-bills pin <PIN 3>, assessed_value "999999999.99"
→ 201 RPT "20000000.00", RPT_SEF "10000000.00" (2% and 1%, rounded to the centavo)
taxpayer_id, property_class, tax_year rules (not automated yet)

T1 · Numbers + · Create the bill
POST /api/v1/training/rpt-bills pin <PIN>, assessed_value "1000000.00"
→ 201 line RPT base_amount "20000.00", line RPT_SEF "10000.00"
Result box "Bill <PIN> created" with lines RPT and RPT_SEF
My data › My bills: see the bill

T3 · Core + · My bill is in My bills
GET /api/v1/training/rpt-bills
→ 200 a row with kind "RPT", ref <PIN>, detail "INDUSTRIAL 2026", amount "1000000.00", status "OPEN"
(also the one UI journey)
